title: ArchToolkit: Archaeology Toolkit for QGIS
description: Comprehensive QGIS plugin for Korean archaeology and cultural heritage GIS workflows (19 tools: DEM generation with TIN/IDW/Ordinary Kriging, terrain derivatives, viewshed/LOS, 4/8/16-neighbor least-cost surface & network, PPA/intervisibility network, AHP suitability with OAT sensitivity, covariate correlation/VIF, KIGAM geology & geochem helpers, cadastral overlap, terrain profile, trench suggestion, map styling, and AOI reporting). Verified against 667+ automated tests and external cross-benchmarks (GRASS GIS 8.4, R 4.5 igraph/terra/stats, GDAL 3.10, SciPy, NetworkX, Shapely).
